# WSO2 API Platform Cloud Documentation

> API Platform Cloud is the WSO2-managed service for designing, securing, deploying, publishing, and governing APIs and AI services.

## Introduction

- [What is API Platform Cloud?](https://wso2.com/api-platform/docs/cloud/platform.md): Learn what API Platform Cloud is and how it helps you manage, secure, and govern APIs and AI services as a WSO2-managed service.
- [Key concepts](https://wso2.com/api-platform/docs/cloud/platform/introduction/key-concepts.md): Learn the core API Platform Cloud concepts, including organizations, projects, environments, and gateways.

## Getting Started

- [Sign up and activate your subscription](https://wso2.com/api-platform/docs/cloud/platform/getting-started/sign-up.md): Create an API Platform Cloud account and activate your subscription so you can start managing APIs.
- [Sign in and organizations](https://wso2.com/api-platform/docs/cloud/platform/getting-started/sign-in-and-organizations.md): Sign in to API Platform Cloud, create or switch organizations, and configure enterprise login.
- [Tour of the Management Portal](https://wso2.com/api-platform/docs/cloud/platform/getting-started/management-portal-tour.md): Find your way around the API Platform Cloud Management Portal and the main tasks you perform in it.
- [Quick start guide](https://wso2.com/api-platform/docs/cloud/platform/getting-started/quick-start-guide.md): Create, deploy, and invoke your first API on API Platform Cloud.

## Develop APIs

- [Create an API](https://wso2.com/api-platform/docs/cloud/platform/develop-apis/create-an-api.md): Create an API in API Platform Cloud using the API types and creation methods the platform supports.
- [Apply policies](https://wso2.com/api-platform/docs/cloud/platform/develop-apis/policies/apply-policies.md): Attach policies to an API in API Platform Cloud to control how the gateway handles requests and responses.
- [Configure policy system parameters](https://wso2.com/api-platform/docs/cloud/platform/develop-apis/policies/configure-system-parameters.md): Configure the system parameters that policies use in API Platform Cloud.
- [Custom policies](https://wso2.com/api-platform/docs/cloud/platform/develop-apis/policies/custom-policies.md): Add your own custom policies to APIs in API Platform Cloud.
- [Build a custom policy with Go](https://wso2.com/api-platform/docs/cloud/platform/develop-apis/policies/build-a-custom-policy-with-go.md): Write a custom gateway policy in Go and use it with your APIs in API Platform Cloud.

## Secure APIs

- [Secure APIs with OAuth 2.0](https://wso2.com/api-platform/docs/cloud/platform/secure-apis/secure-apis-with-oauth2.md): Protect your APIs in API Platform Cloud with OAuth 2.0 access tokens.
- [Manage secrets](https://wso2.com/api-platform/docs/cloud/platform/secure-apis/manage-secrets.md): Store and use secrets such as backend credentials and API keys in API Platform Cloud.

## Deploy

- [Environments](https://wso2.com/api-platform/docs/cloud/platform/deploy/environments.md): Learn how environments work in API Platform Cloud and how to manage them.
- [Promote APIs between environments](https://wso2.com/api-platform/docs/cloud/platform/deploy/promote-apis-between-environments.md): Promote an API from one environment to the next in API Platform Cloud.
- [Internal and external gateways](https://wso2.com/api-platform/docs/cloud/platform/deploy/gateways/internal-and-external-gateways.md): Learn the difference between internal and external gateways in API Platform Cloud and when to use each one.
- [Custom gateway domains](https://wso2.com/api-platform/docs/cloud/platform/deploy/gateways/custom-gateway-domains.md): Configure a custom domain for a gateway in API Platform Cloud.

## Publish and Consume

- [Publish APIs to the Developer Portal](https://wso2.com/api-platform/docs/cloud/platform/publish-and-consume/publish-apis-to-the-developer-portal.md): Publish your APIs from API Platform Cloud to the Developer Portal so that consumers can discover and use them.
- [Developer Portal](https://wso2.com/api-platform/docs/cloud/platform/publish-and-consume/developer-portal.md): Learn how API consumers use the Developer Portal to discover, subscribe to, and try your APIs.

## AI Workspace

- [AI Workspace overview](https://wso2.com/api-platform/docs/cloud/platform/ai-workspace/overview.md): Learn how AI Workspace in API Platform Cloud manages AI Gateways, LLM providers, App LLM proxies, MCP proxies, and AI policies from one control plane.
- [Get started with AI Workspace](https://wso2.com/api-platform/docs/cloud/platform/ai-workspace/quickstart.md): Connect an AI Gateway to AI Workspace, configure an LLM provider and an MCP proxy, and call both through the gateway in API Platform Cloud.
- [Getting started with AI Workspace](https://wso2.com/api-platform/docs/cloud/platform/ai-workspace/getting-started.md): Create an AI Gateway, configure an LLM provider, and deploy the provider to the gateway through AI Workspace in API Platform Cloud.
- [Set up an AI Gateway](https://wso2.com/api-platform/docs/cloud/platform/ai-workspace/ai-gateways/setting-up.md): Register an AI Gateway in AI Workspace, connect the gateway runtime with a registration token, and edit or delete existing gateways.
- [LLM providers overview](https://wso2.com/api-platform/docs/cloud/platform/ai-workspace/llm-providers/overview.md): Learn how LLM providers connect AI services such as OpenAI, Anthropic, and Azure OpenAI to AI Workspace in API Platform Cloud.
- [Configure an LLM provider](https://wso2.com/api-platform/docs/cloud/platform/ai-workspace/llm-providers/configure-provider.md): Add an LLM provider in AI Workspace, set its authentication and guardrails, and deploy it to an AI gateway in API Platform Cloud.
- [Manage an LLM provider](https://wso2.com/api-platform/docs/cloud/platform/ai-workspace/llm-providers/manage-provider.md): Configure the connection, access control, security, rate limits, guardrails, and models of a deployed LLM provider, then redeploy or delete it.
- [App LLM proxies overview](https://wso2.com/api-platform/docs/cloud/platform/ai-workspace/llm-proxies/overview.md): Learn when to add an App LLM proxy on top of an LLM provider to give a Gen AI application or agent its own endpoint and controls.
- [Configure an App LLM proxy](https://wso2.com/api-platform/docs/cloud/platform/ai-workspace/llm-proxies/configure-proxy.md): Create an App LLM proxy in AI Workspace, attach guardrails, deploy it to an AI gateway, and get its invoke URL and API key.
- [Manage an App LLM proxy](https://wso2.com/api-platform/docs/cloud/platform/ai-workspace/llm-proxies/manage-proxy.md): Change an App LLM proxy's provider, resources, client authentication, and guardrails in AI Workspace, then save, redeploy, or delete it.
- [MCP proxies overview](https://wso2.com/api-platform/docs/cloud/platform/ai-workspace/mcp-proxies/overview.md): Learn what the Model Context Protocol is and how an MCP proxy in AI Workspace adds security, policies, and observability to MCP traffic.
- [Configure an MCP proxy](https://wso2.com/api-platform/docs/cloud/platform/ai-workspace/mcp-proxies/configure-proxy.md): Create an MCP proxy for an upstream MCP server in AI Workspace, deploy it to an AI gateway, and connect MCP clients to its URL.
- [Apply policies to an MCP proxy](https://wso2.com/api-platform/docs/cloud/platform/ai-workspace/mcp-proxies/apply-policies.md): Apply authentication, authorization, access control, and rewrite policies to an MCP proxy in AI Workspace to govern MCP traffic.
- [What is an MCP registry?](https://wso2.com/api-platform/docs/cloud/platform/ai-workspace/mcp-registry/mcp-registry.md): Learn how the API Platform Cloud MCP registry catalogs published MCP proxies and exposes them through the MCP Hub and the MCP Registry API.
- [Publish MCP proxies to the MCP Hub](https://wso2.com/api-platform/docs/cloud/platform/ai-workspace/mcp-registry/publish-mcp-proxies.md): Publish a deployed MCP proxy from AI Workspace so that it is discoverable through the MCP Hub and the MCP Registry API.
- [Browse the MCP Hub](https://wso2.com/api-platform/docs/cloud/platform/ai-workspace/mcp-registry/browse-mcp-hub.md): Explore the MCP servers registered in your organization's MCP Hub and review their tools, resources, prompts, and connection details.
- [Use the MCP Registry API](https://wso2.com/api-platform/docs/cloud/platform/ai-workspace/mcp-registry/mcp-registry-api.md): Query the MCP Registry API to list your organization's MCP servers, their versions, and the connection details AI clients need.
- [GenAI applications](https://wso2.com/api-platform/docs/cloud/platform/ai-workspace/genai-applications.md): Group API keys under a named GenAI application in AI Workspace for application-level usage visibility, analytics, and governance.
- [Configure inbound authentication](https://wso2.com/api-platform/docs/cloud/platform/ai-workspace/configure-inbound-auth.md): Control where and under what name client applications send their API key when they call a deployed LLM provider or App LLM proxy.
- [Invoke providers and proxies via SDKs](https://wso2.com/api-platform/docs/cloud/platform/ai-workspace/using-sdks.md): Call a deployed LLM provider or App LLM proxy from the OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Mistral, Azure OpenAI, or LangChain SDKs.
- [AI Workspace policies overview](https://wso2.com/api-platform/docs/cloud/platform/ai-workspace/policies/overview.md): Apply built-in guardrail, rate limit, and traffic management policies to LLM providers and App LLM proxies in AI Workspace.
- [AI Workspace guardrails overview](https://wso2.com/api-platform/docs/cloud/platform/ai-workspace/policies/guardrails/overview.md): Detect unsafe content, mask sensitive data, and enforce content limits on LLM traffic using guardrails configured in AI Workspace.
- [PII masking regex guardrail](https://wso2.com/api-platform/docs/cloud/platform/ai-workspace/policies/guardrails/regex-pii-masking.md): Detect and mask personally identifiable information in LLM requests and responses using regex patterns configured in AI Workspace.
- [Azure Content Safety content moderation](https://wso2.com/api-platform/docs/cloud/platform/ai-workspace/policies/guardrails/azure-content-safety.md): Filter hate, sexual, self-harm, and violent content in LLM requests and responses with the Azure Content Safety guardrail in AI Workspace.
- [Word count guardrail](https://wso2.com/api-platform/docs/cloud/platform/ai-workspace/policies/guardrails/word-count-guardrail.md): Enforce minimum and maximum word counts on LLM prompts or responses with the Word Count Guardrail in AI Workspace.
- [Sentence count guardrail](https://wso2.com/api-platform/docs/cloud/platform/ai-workspace/policies/guardrails/sentence-count-guardrail.md): Enforce minimum and maximum sentence counts on LLM prompts or responses with the Sentence Count Guardrail in AI Workspace.
- [LLM cost](https://wso2.com/api-platform/docs/cloud/platform/ai-workspace/policies/rate-limit/llm-cost.md): Calculate the USD cost of each LLM call from token usage and pricing tier, so the LLM cost-based rate limit can enforce spending budgets.
- [Token-based rate limit](https://wso2.com/api-platform/docs/cloud/platform/ai-workspace/policies/rate-limit/token-based-rate-limit.md): Limit LLM traffic by prompt, completion, or total token consumption within a time window that you configure in AI Workspace.
- [LLM cost-based rate limit](https://wso2.com/api-platform/docs/cloud/platform/ai-workspace/policies/rate-limit/llm-cost-based-rate-limit.md): Enforce monetary spending budgets on LLM traffic in AI Workspace, using the cost that the LLM cost policy calculates for each call.
- [Model round robin](https://wso2.com/api-platform/docs/cloud/platform/ai-workspace/policies/other-policies/model-round-robin.md): Distribute LLM requests across several models in round-robin order in AI Workspace, and suspend models that fail so traffic shifts to healthy ones.
- [Prompt decorator](https://wso2.com/api-platform/docs/cloud/platform/ai-workspace/policies/other-policies/prompt-decorator.md): Prepend or append system instructions or context to every LLM request in AI Workspace, without changing the client application.
- [Prompt template](https://wso2.com/api-platform/docs/cloud/platform/ai-workspace/policies/other-policies/prompt-template.md): Apply reusable, parameterized prompt templates to LLM requests in AI Workspace, so clients send a template:// reference instead of a raw prompt.
- [Semantic cache](https://wso2.com/api-platform/docs/cloud/platform/ai-workspace/policies/other-policies/semantic-cache.md): Cache LLM responses in AI Workspace using vector embeddings and cosine similarity, and serve similar requests without calling the upstream LLM.
- [Writing an AI policy](https://wso2.com/api-platform/docs/cloud/platform/ai-workspace/policies/writing-an-ai-policy.md): Write a custom AI policy in Go that inspects and modifies LLM traffic and handles both streaming (SSE) and non-streaming responses.

## Govern

- [API governance](https://wso2.com/api-platform/docs/cloud/platform/govern/api-governance.md): Apply governance rules to your APIs in API Platform Cloud and review compliance.

## Administer

- [Users and roles](https://wso2.com/api-platform/docs/cloud/platform/administer/users-and-roles.md): Invite users to your API Platform Cloud organization and control what they can do with roles.
- [Event notifications](https://wso2.com/api-platform/docs/cloud/platform/administer/event-notifications.md): Receive notifications when events occur in your API Platform Cloud organization.

## Platform API

- [Platform API overview and authentication](https://wso2.com/api-platform/docs/cloud/platform/platform-api/overview.md): Learn what the API Platform Cloud Platform API offers and how to authenticate your requests to it.
- [Events reference](https://wso2.com/api-platform/docs/cloud/platform/platform-api/events-reference.md): Reference for the events that API Platform Cloud emits through the Platform API.
- [Platform API reference](https://wso2.com/api-platform/docs/cloud/platform/platform-api/api-reference.md): Reference for the API Platform Cloud Platform API operations.
